summary: Every call in openbao-backup.sh.j2 now goes through a curl helper without -f; a failure ends the run naming the call's method and path, the HTTP status (or curl exit code) and OpenBao's error strings, while the upload logs its status only, and nothing logs a body, token or secret_id. Proven by an 18-case local harness (OpenBao 2.5.4 on raft storage plus mocks, no leaks found), not live; the ansible gate is green, and the code and plan commits are in.
